flipToBack.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction on any table change (NOT flagged singleton in source)
flipToBack.prose: Flip if Krennic or Tarkin is at a Scarif battleground site AND a Death Star system is orbiting Scarif.

children.req: can-spot (at): Krennic or Tarkin at a Scarif battleground site
card-state (orbit): Death Star system orbiting Scarif

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if you do NOT have a leader at a Scarif battleground site. Separately (checked first), back is PLACED OUT OF PLAY if Death Star system or Shield Gate is not on table.

children.req: can-spot (at): your leader at a Scarif battleground site

requirementSemantics: Front flip: can-spot AT (Filters.at) a Scarif battleground SITE for Krennic/Tarkin - persona presence at site class, not control or occupy; plus an orbit-state check on the Death Star system (Filters.isOrbiting(Title.Scarif)).
Back flip-back: absence of ANY of your leaders (Filters.leader keyword) at a Scarif battleground site; Krennic/Tarkin count as leaders but any leader holds it.

Back HARD LOSE is separate and stronger: out of play if no Death Star system on table OR no Shield Gate on table (plain canSpot, no SpotOverride, no canBeFlipped gate) (Card216_011_BACK.java:155-168).
Note: back hard-lose checks broad Filters.Death_Star_system (any printing), not the [Set 16] icon-gated version used for the setup pull.
typedIdentities: Deploy ban: Filters.or(Filters.Endor_Shield, Filters.and(Filters.character, Filters.not(Filters.Imperial)), Filters.and(Filters.starship, Filters.not(Filters.Imperial_starship)))
Back destiny locations: Filters.or(Filters.Death_Star_system, Filters.isOrbitedBy(Filters.Death_Star_system)) plus related sites via Filters.relatedSiteTo(self, ...)
setupAndPullRoutes: Setup (required on objective deploy): deploy [Set 16] Death Star system (Icon.VIRTUAL_SET_16 + Filters.Death_Star_system), Scarif system, Citadel Tower (Filters.title(Title.Scarif_Citadel_Tower)), and Shield Gate from Reserve Deck (Card216_011.java:46-77).

Both sides once per turn (ON_THE_VERGE_OF_GREATNESS__DEPLOY_SCARIF_BATTLEGROUND, shared id): deploy a Scarif battleground (Filters.and(Filters.Scarif_location, Filters.battleground)) from Reserve Deck (Card216_011.java:80-99; Card216_011_BACK.java:118-134).
Back once during your draw phase (TAKING_CONTROL_OF_THE_WEAPON__RETRIEVE_NON_UNIQUE_CARD_WITH_ABILITY): retrieve a non-unique card with ability (Card216_011_BACK.java:136-150).
otherObligations: Front remainder-of-game deploy ban: no Endor Shield, non-Imperial characters, or non-Imperial starships (Card216_011.java:104-106).
Front: your non-unique Imperials/vehicles/capital starships deploy -1 (-2 for Star Destroyers) (:107-109); non-unique Imperials forfeit +1 (:110-112).
Back: A Bright Center To The Universe cancels opponent's Force drain modifiers everywhere (ModifyGameText) (Card216_011_BACK.java:65).
Back: +1 total battle destiny (+2 with your non-unique ability card in battle) at Death Star, orbited system, and related sites (:66-67).
Back: Vader may make a regular move to a just-initiated battle (OptionalGameTextTriggerAction) (:72-112).
Back HARD LOSE: placed out of play if Death Star system or Shield Gate not on table (:155-168). Protect Shield Gate (a DEVICE) and the Death Star system at all costs after flip.
Flip-back exposure: always keep a leader at a Scarif battleground site after flip.

orbit condition (Death Star system isOrbiting Scarif) exists only as a recipe string in objectiveNamedLocations, with no structured gate semantics
